args.summary: 西红柿炒蛋 is cooked in Wang Gang's style and plated safely. (1) 润锅: the wok was heated, oiled, and the oil poured out into the oil cup. (2) The 150 g of beaten eggs went in at about 120 °C. They fried on low heat (0.3) until set, were flipped once and fried on the other side, then were taken out into the holding bowl at about 151 °C. (3) 300 g of tomato wedges, 1 g salt and 1 g sugar fried on low heat with stirring, then 5 g ketchup went in. (4) 60 g water went in and simmered at medium heat (0.5) for about a minute, holding about 100 °C. (5) 25 g starch water thickened the sauce, then 5 g finishing oil (明油) went on top. (6) With the heat off, the eggs (140 g, plus 20 g oil carried over from frying) went back in and were stirred 5 strokes, then everything was tipped onto the plate and the wok was rinsed. Peak temperature was 151 °C, well below the 210 °C smoke detector and the 250 °C guard. Deviations: the 1 g white vinegar was skipped, the eggs were beaten by the user beforehand, and the eggs were judged done by time and temperature (about 60 s per side) rather than checked visually.

decision.expect: The episode ends with the tomato and egg dish on the plate, no smoke alarm and no power cut.
